listing.name: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy (single player and multiplayer) (OpenJK / OpenJO)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Official continuous Windows/Linux/macOS packages for both game executables. Limits: Jedi Outcast SP works but needs attention; Outcast MP unsupported. Jedi Academy SP/MP maintained. Upstream platforms: Official continuous Windows/Linux/macOS builds. README names Windows x86, Linux i386/x86-64 and ARM/Apple-Silicon source support; selected asset CPU must be resolved per target/package. Original data: Own installed Jedi Academy game data (Steam/GOG/retail or the documented Mac App Store layout); extract OpenJK into its GameData directory. This target covers Academy SP and MP. Exact accepted patch/revision remains Unknown in the retained README. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
